notes.title: Runeverse is back!
notes.notes:
We are finally proud to announce that we have completed the first beta phase of Runeverse and are now presenting you with a stable and entertaining game!

Runeverse combines the most beloved mechanics from the best card games to offer you a fast-paced, fun, and highly strategic gaming experience.

[b]- New Graphics[/b]
We have completely revamped Runeverse, introducing a new captivating graphics design that combines 2D and 3D elements, making the game even smoother and more enjoyable to play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43291747/27db996f1971bd9e2997223c27f125c83c31ea98.jpg[/img]

[b]- Sea Brawl: Automatic Battles![/b]
One of the main strengths of Runeverse is its engaging automatic battle system, featuring over 100 different minions, 50 Hero Powers, and numerous Spells and Abilities.

For those who have already enjoyed the autobattler "Sea Brawl," you'll be pleased to know that we're bringing even more action and excitement to this popular game mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43291747/5bb19ef671a69de42ae1d0e38fecf7e5fb9b7b2a.jpg[/img]

[b]- New Season[/b]
Moreover, we have fantastic news for you: the new gaming season starts today! Get ready to challenge other players, climb the leaderboard, and prove to everyone that you're the best in Runeverse!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43291747/dab57103d1243ec4054badf9527a9f5507349f87.jpg[/img]

[b]- Cash Prize Tournament[/b]
And that's not all: in the coming days, we'll be announcing an exciting cash prize contest! Stay tuned to find out how to participate and compete for fantastic prizes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43291747/611c8cdacf435b5510de9c00f8e0bddd571946c3.jpg[/img]

[b]- Availability[/b]
Don't waste any time, join us in the fascinating world of Runeverse and start your adventure right away!

Runeverse is available for FREE on Steam. Don't miss the chance to join this epic adventure and challenge friends and foes from all around the world!

Download Runeverse now and get ready for the most epic relaunch ever! Don't forget to join our Discord and share your feats on social media and invite your friends to join the battle. See you in the Runeverse!

notes.title: Runeverse Early Access
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome to the Early Access of Runeverse.[/b]
Runeverse is [b]back[/b]! And it's better than ever!

We are releasing a single game that will stand as a [b]unified platform[/b] for [b]card games[/b].

This time with a simpler and more immediate style, improved graphics, [b]2D[/b] and much more.

[b]Sea Brawl[/b] will also shortly make its comeback with a dedicated section inside the game, and we have plenty of game modes and other surprises in store.

The game is in Early Access, if you experience bugs, errors, issues or inaccuracies please join us on our [b]Discord[/b] server ([url=https://discord.gg/Nd7rVCNvhU]https://discord.gg/Nd7rVCNvhU[/url]) so we can discuss the game and meet other players.

You can visit our [b]website[/b] ([url=https://playruneverse.com/]https://playruneverse.com/[/url]) to find some ideas for [b]decks[/b], comment on them or share new ones.

Also coming soon are the various [b]translations[/b] into major languages and apps on mobile platforms.
We will as well announce [b]tournaments[/b] and other [b]events[/b] in the coming months.

We look forward to battling you in the arena!

Enjoy,
Runeverse Team.
